titre: Synthesis Test n°3 — English (6th year primary)

exercices.enonce:
Read the text:
Eid is a happy celebration in Tunisia. During the holidays, families visit their grandparents and give presents to children. My family always celebrates Eid together. My mother cooks a big meal with meat, vegetables and fruit. We wear new clothes and eat sweet cakes. Last year, we travelled to Sousse by train to see my aunt. We visited the beach and ate healthy food. It was a wonderful holiday and I was very happy.

Answer:
1) What do families do during the holidays? (1 pt)
2) What does the mother cook? (1,5 pt)
3) How did the family travel to Sousse last year? (1 pt)
4) How did the child feel? (1,5 pt)

Complete with: will / by / celebrate / healthy
1) We ...... Eid with our family.
2) They travelled to Sousse ...... train.
3) Fruit and vegetables are ...... food.
4) Next year, we ...... visit our grandparents.

Match the word with the group:
1) train     a) celebration
2) apple     b) transport
3) Eid       c) healthy food

Put the words in the right order:
1) Eid / celebrate / We / . 
2) train / travelled / We / by / . 
3) food / like / healthy / I / .

Writing:
Write 4 to 5 sentences about a holiday or celebration you like (what you do, what you eat, how you feel).

Grammar: past simple (-ed).
Most regular verbs add -ed to talk about the past (visit -> visited).
Write the past simple.
1) visit -> ..........
2) travel -> ..........
3) play -> ..........
